The [[Miniature Eye of Janthir]] is a miniature version of the [[Eye of Janthir]].

==Acquisition==
*[[Core]]
**Randomly awarded from a [[Birthday Present]] which is received when a [[character]] reaches 48 and 84 months old.

==Notes==
*Unlike the original, which is floating over the heads of the [[character]]s and sending out surges from time to time, the miniature will float on the ground without surges.
* Instead of electricity surges, when it enters its battle stance, the blue mist-like ring around it will turn into fire.
*This miniature emits a low humming sound when outside of a [[guild hall]], [[outpost]] or [[town]].
